gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-modi: Expressive from the first glance, Tektur bends its strokes like pipe cleaner. Noto Sans Modi is the quieter partner, with daylight inside every curve and lowercase that sits close to the capitals in height.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-mono: Tektur's strokes look like neatly bent pipe cleaner, with every curve left generously open at its ends. Noto Sans Mono, a plain sans, rewards a slightly larger size.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-mro: Dense and tall through the middle, Noto Sans Mro packs its words tightly. Tektur is best at flat, unmodulated lines that announce themselves, while Noto Sans Mro is best at wide entrances that let a sans-serif text stay readable.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-multani: Tektur draws its letters with no hairlines at all, and its lowercase runs outsized next to ordinary proportions. Noto Sans Multani, a plain sans with a lofty x-height, lets the eye glide along.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Tektur keeps one uninterrupted monoline stroke throughout, each curve opening generously at its ends. Noto Sans Myanmar forms a thick, heavy-looking band of sans-serif text, and its broad c keeps that weight inviting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Distinctive in every glyph, Tektur skips thick-and-thin modulation entirely and lets its oversized lowercase stand out. Noto Sans Nabataean does the quiet work, with wide s curves.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Noto Sans Nag Mundari is a plain sans whose c and s look half unwrapped, with lowercase rivaling the capitals. Tektur traces every glyph with one thickness, while Noto Sans Nag Mundari would make a long passage feel spacious and unhurried.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Approachable and big-bodied, Noto Sans Nandinagari keeps its sans-serif openings generous at every weight, with short ascenders. Tektur is best at squeezed-toothpaste lines with a strange, bent charm; Noto Sans Nandinagari is best at easy text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa reads as a sans-serif with a clearly open mouth on its e and tall bowls. Tektur has no hairlines to squint at, so it holds its shape up top while Newa carries the text below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu towers with a huge x-height, terminals held far from the stroke. Tektur, with its flat line weight, feels like a bent-wire sketch beside it, and Nushu feels like a sturdy sans.
